# MedBill Analyzer

> A second opinion on your medical bill. Check its charges against official CMS Medicare reference rates and draft a letter requesting a review.

MedBill Analyzer is an anonymous, informational web tool. A user uploads a medical bill
(image or PDF); it reads the billing codes and charges with OCR, compares each code
to two official CMS fee schedules (the Physician Fee Schedule and the Clinical Laboratory
Fee Schedule), shows each charge as a multiple of the Medicare reference rate, and can
draft a letter requesting a review. There are no accounts. Uploads are processed in memory
and never stored. Codes not found in the CMS data are marked "Unverified" and are not
compared to any rate. Only CPT/HCPCS codes written as five digits are recognized; dental
CDT codes are not covered.

## Pages
- [Home](https://medbill.kyuruki.cc/): what MedBill Analyzer is and how to start.
- [How it works](https://medbill.kyuruki.cc/how-it-works): the OCR → CMS-comparison pipeline, step by step.
- [FAQ](https://medbill.kyuruki.cc/faq): how charges are compared, what CMS rates mean, privacy, and affiliations.
- [Privacy](https://medbill.kyuruki.cc/privacy): how a bill is handled (in memory, not stored).
- [About](https://medbill.kyuruki.cc/about): why the tool exists and its independence.
- [Analyze a bill](https://medbill.kyuruki.cc/analyze): the tool itself.

## Important context
- Informational only; not legal, medical, or financial advice.
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to CMS, Medicare, or any insurer.
- Medicare reference rates are a benchmark, not a statement of what a patient owes. Nearly
  every US charge sits above the Medicare rate — negotiated commercial rates commonly run
  around two to three times it — so a multiple above 1x is normal, not a finding. Only far
  outliers are a prompt to request an itemized justification, and never an accusation.
